name: Making Friends
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of choosing friends wisely, as the company one keeps greatly influences one's character and destiny. Walking with the wise leads to wisdom, while associating with the foolish brings destruction, and friendships with the unrighteous can lead others astray. True friendship is marked by steadfast love and loyalty, especially in times of adversity, and genuine friends demonstrate friendliness and closeness beyond mere acquaintance. Believers are also warned to avoid forming close ties with those prone to anger, highlighting the need for discernment in relationships.
